notes: REFIT v3 (verifier fix pass). 'previs' = the best fit with the CURRENT builder and is UNCHANGED from v2 (re-rendered with the live builder: identical frames): the verifier's two major issues (mannequin shoulders +34% vs head -10%; booth arch / corner neon strips missing and a spurious dark 0.3 m 'camera window' behind the head) are builder geometry, and I tried every existing lever: scale/lens/camera distance (head and shoulders scale together, so closing the head -10% opens the shoulders to +49%, shrinking the shoulders to +15% opens the head to -23%), figure_yaw (a 25 deg body turn only trims the shoulders by ~6% and turns the visor, so frontal orientation is lost), camera z / x / figure x (the window is a 0.3 m SQUARE 0.66 m behind a 0.23 m round head, parallax can shift it but not hide it; moving camera x to -0.06 to put the booth corners on the real neon strips pushes the window out beside the head, so the v2 centred layout stays the best compromise: head 2.7% right of real, corner bands 1.6-3.5% off). Real clip (window 1.00-2.38 s, previs frames 259-292): locked-off level frontal bust inside the booth (no motion), silver wall, curved magenta neon arch at the very top (x 20-80%, y 0-9%), cyan vertical neon strips at the side-wall corners (x 6.6-10% and 97.6-100%), man centred at x ~47.5% (hair top y 85, chin y 340, head 255 x 220 px), jacket 430-440 px wide at the shoulder line widening to ~515 px at the frame bottom, sunglasses pushed up on the hair; hand on the chin for the first ~0.4 s, then arms down and the head tilts to the image left, wink; flash = one white-out frame at window frame 10 (0.42 s) plus a decay frame. Everything else of v2 is kept: static camera (0,-0.81,1.2) 35 mm aimed at (0,1,1.2), flash cue at 0.42 s lands on window frame 10 (mean luma 108 -> 200 -> 136, real 96 -> 231 -> 188, same frames). FIX = builder patch (see builder_requests, patch file previs/refit/S10_S11_builder_requests.patch, parameters in 'previs_with_builder_patch', look in S10_compare_proposed_builder.jpg). With that patch (tested on a scratch copy, original untouched) the measured silhouette at 1280x720 is: hair top y 86 (real 85), chin ~339 (340), head width 217 px at y 250 (real ~220), head centre x 590-600 (real 605-610), width at the shoulder row y 432 = 458 px (real ~440, +4% instead of +34%), at the frame bottom 457 (real ~515, -11%); booth neon strips at 7.2-9.1% and 97.9-99.1% of the frame width (real 6.6-10% / 97.6-100%), curved arch across the top at y 24-63 px at the centre and 0-18 px at x 300 (real ~25-65 / 0-15), the camera window is gone, the hand sits on the chin until 0.38 s and the arms drop by 0.55 s with a 9 deg head tilt, flash frame unchanged. Remaining mismatches even with the patch: the arms hang straight (real sleeves flare out, -11% width at the bottom), the head tilt is a fixed 9 deg (real tilts 0-12 deg and winks), side-wall bands left/right of the strips are flat dark grey (real: lit silver/pink wall), no mirror/reflection look. Current-builder residual (honest): head 230 px (-10%), shoulders 595 px (+34% at the shoulder row), no arch / no corner strips (dark bands at ~5% / 95% instead), a dark window box behind the head, pose 'stand' only (no hand-on-chin, no tilt).

builder_requests.problem: build_figure proportions: head 0.2 x 0.23 m vs shoulder-ball span 0.58 m. In the S10 close-up the real man's head is 255 x 220 px and his jacket 440 px at the shoulder line (ratio 0.5), the mannequin's is 0.34; fitting the head (-10%) leaves the shoulders at +34% and there is no existing param that changes the ratio.
builder_requests.request: new optional previs keys 'figure_scale' (float, default 1: uniform scale of the whole mannequin about its root, applied on the 'lean' empty so the 'appear' scale cue is untouched) and 'head_scale' (float, default 1, scale of the head empty about the neck). S10 uses figure_scale 0.76, head_scale 1.43 (head 1.09x the old size, shoulders 0.76x) and raises figure_path z by 0.28 m to put the shoulder line back (scaling is about the root on the floor). Implemented in the patch (docstring, build_shot after animate_figure).

builder_requests.problem: build_booth has no neon: no curved arch across the top and no cyan strips at the side-wall back corners (they are flat dark grey side-wall bands), and it always adds a 0.3 x 0.3 m dark 'camera window' box on the back wall at z 1.5 that sits behind/above the head (16% x 28% of the frame) and does not exist in the real clip.
builder_requests.request: new optional previs key 'env_opts' (dict, default {} = old look). Booth entries: 'window' (0/1, default 1), 'arch' [x_c, z_c, half_width, sag, (thickness)] (a smile-shaped light ribbon on the back wall; S10: [-0.045, 1.643, 0.6, 0.09, 0.06]), 'strips' [[x, width], ...] (full-height light boxes at the back wall; S10: [[-0.87,0.075],[0.89,0.08]]). Implemented in build_booth(tag, world, opts) as an extra 'neon' mesh in the 'light' colour. S10 also moves the camera and figure x by -0.06 / -0.096 so the booth corners land on the real strips (the real booth is centred ~0.06 m right of the camera axis).

builder_requests.problem: no way to get the real hand-on-chin first 0.4 s followed by arms down (the 'poses' action lifts both hands and flings the arms out, which the clip never does).
builder_requests.request: new figure_action 'chin': right hand on the chin until 0.38 s, arms down by 0.55 s, 9 deg head tilt afterwards (fixed seconds, meant for the 1.4 s S10 shot). Arm angles from a forward-kinematics fit (sh_R (48,0,0), el_R (126,0,51)); in the patch as one elif in animate_figure.

proposed_files.usage: to use the patch: apply it to previs/build_previs.py (applies cleanly alone and after S07_builder_requests.patch), then replace the shot's previs block by 'previs_with_builder_patch'. Without the patch keep 'previs'.
